justification: New feature wiring existing backend engine to frontend — 7 files changed, DB queries involved, but engine logic itself is unchanged and already tested (103 tests in PR #460)

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls (lga, control_type, value_min/max, is_current), housing_sepp_standards (development_type, standard_type, numeric_value, applicable_zones)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If no DCP/SEPP rows exist for a given LGA/zone, empty arrays sent to engine — engine handles gracefully with 'data gaps' list
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Read-only queries — no writes. Engine is pure function returning computed result
pre_impl.external_source_error: Railway returns non-200 → 502 to client → error state in component (amber card with 'unavailable' message)
pre_impl.frontend_type: New ConstraintArithmeticResult interface mirrors Python model exactly
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If Railway down: amber card 'Development yield computation unavailable'. If DB error: empty DCP/SEPP → engine computes with gaps → low confidence badge

functions.name: constraint_arithmetic_endpoint
functions.input: ConstraintArithmeticRequest pydantic model validated by FastAPI framework
functions.output: ConstraintArithmeticResult pydantic model enforced by response_model decorator
functions.if_none: Pydantic returns 422 for missing required fields (lot_area_m2, dev_type)

functions.name: POST /api/constraint-arithmetic
functions.output: { success: true, data: ConstraintArithmeticResult } or error

functions.name: fetchDcpControls
functions.if_none: Returns [] if formerCouncil is falsy or query errors

functions.name: fetchSeppStandards
functions.input: pool connection, optional zone string for filtering
functions.if_none: Returns [] on query error; queries all standards if no zone prefix

functions.name: computeSeppLepOverrides
functions.if_none: Returns [] if no standards have values exceeding LEP

values.if_missing: 503 error → component shows amber error card

values.guard_at: route.ts:79 — null-checked with != null before String()
values.if_missing: Passed as null to engine → engine reports data gaps

values.guard_at: ConstraintArithmeticCard.tsx:180 — returns null if no result

values.if_missing: No DCP controls sent → engine computes without setbacks

queries.purpose: Fetch DCP setback controls for the LGA
queries.if_zero: Empty array → engine computes without setback data, reports gap
queries.if_wrong: Wrong LGA match would return wrong setbacks — mitigated by exact match on formerCouncil.toLowerCase()

queries.purpose: Fetch SEPP Housing standards for zone
queries.where_clause: WHERE $1 = ANY(applicable_zones) or no WHERE (all standards)
queries.if_zero: Empty array → no SEPP overrides computed, engine uses LEP values only
queries.if_wrong: Zone prefix mismatch could miss standards — mitigated by splitting on space and uppercasing

break_it.scenario: Railway Python API is down or unreachable
break_it.what_happens: User sees amber card: 'Development yield computation unavailable'
break_it.how: route.ts:89-96 catches non-ok responses, returns 502; component:165-178 renders error state
break_it.repro: Set PYTHON_API_URL to invalid URL, load assessment page with valid address

break_it.scenario: formerCouncil is null (some addresses lack this mapping)
break_it.what_happens: No DCP controls fetched → engine runs without setbacks → realistic_gfa higher than reality
break_it.how: Engine reports 'DCP setback data not available' in gaps array; confidence drops to medium/low
break_it.repro: Search an address where formerCouncil is not set in the property response

break_it.scenario: Zone prefix extraction fails (unusual zone format like 'SP3 - Tourism')
break_it.what_happens: SEPP standards query may miss applicable standards if zone prefix doesn't match applicable_zones array
break_it.how: Partial mitigation: if no zone provided, ALL standards returned. But wrong prefix could miss matches
break_it.repro: Test with zone='SP3 - Tourism' and check if SEPP standards are returned

post_merge.secrets: No — uses existing PYTHON_API_URL env var
post_merge.manual_verify: No — 7 endpoint tests cover all data availability paths; component handles loading/error/null/partial states
